parsed.post: Increased DEPTH from 4 to 6 and added a small warmup. This brought val_bpb down from 1.067 to 1.059. Larger models appear to scale better within the 5-minute budget. Next: I'll try increasing the MATRIX_LR slightly more to see if it pushes convergence further, keeping the warmup to prevent instability.
parsed.description: Testing a slightly higher learning rate (0.1 -> 0.12) while maintaining the 5% warmup to accelerate convergence in the fixed time budget.
